title: Anonymous tourism sunday newsletter flat

change.control: Send monthly promotional newsletter on Monday.
change.variant: Send the same monthly promotional newsletter on Sunday.

significance.reported: Low-confidence underperformance; no statistically significant difference from Monday reported.

quote: The remaining days —Thursday, Friday and Sunday — underperformed, though they had low levels of confidence.
notes: One arm versus Monday in a seven-day split test, not a separate independent study. Numeric arm lift is not published in body text. Clickthrough was also inconclusive. Classified by tourism promotion rather than a paid newsletter subscription.
